body_markdown: AST SpaceMobile launched the first of its next-generation satellites to low Earth orbit on December 23, 2025 at 10:25 p.m. EST. The mission, called BlueBird 6, lifted off from the Satish Dhawan Space Center aboard an LVM3 rocket. Watch AST SpaceMobile’s webcast featuring new videos, a word from President Scott Wisniewski, a tour of our Midland facility, and interviews with our strategic partners American Tower and Rakuten.
